title: Ledger and Witness
author: Tamsin Joubert
blurb: Mirabel Pemberton, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
